purpose: Define each machine-checkable or manually evidenced compliance/security control as an explicit identity with scope, requirement and evaluation semantics.

topics.name: Compliance Control Identity
topics.purpose: Define each machine-checkable or manually evidenced compliance/security control as an explicit identity with scope, requirement and evaluation semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each control has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.frequency_rule: Evaluation cadence/event trigger is explicit where applicable.
semantics.authority_rule: Control definition does not grant system authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: control inferred from checklist text only
